content.text: Buffy the Vampire Slayer Collectible Card Game is a licensed commercial trading card duel based on the Buffy television setting.
Published as a licensed trading card game, Buffy the Vampire Slayer CCG uses constructed decks, named characters, locations, and printed card effects to model conflicts from the television series.
2 players use the table arrangement described for Buffy the Vampire Slayer Collectible Card Game.
Constructed Buffy the Vampire Slayer CCG decks
Constructed Buffy the Vampire Slayer CCG decks, score area, and enough table space for play.
Each player brings a constructed deck and draws an opening hand under the game rules.
